thread:
mia: starting 2.8.0 canary in USW (10%). quick FYI: release notes weren't updated with the embeddings fallback detail.
jon: saw the deploybot ping. what's the signal?
deploybot: ALERT: canary embeddings p95 +18% over baseline (6m). Auto-rollback criteria: p95 >=20% OR errors >=0.5% sustained 5m. Current: p95 +18% (6m), errors 0.06%.
mia: that's close. i'd rather hold and add the release note then decide. not ready to let auto-rollback flip unless it crosses.
ops-oncall: agree hold. manual pin approved. if it crosses to >=20% we let auto-rollback do the thing; otherwise manual rollback authority stays with ops.
mia: applying hold now. `/deploy hold --slice=canary --region=usw`
deploybot: ACTION: hold applied by mia. Canary traffic frozen at 10%. Auto-rollback still enabled.
bd-team: Heads-up: revenue team asked for explicit line about embedding fallback to CPU for long sequences. i'll draft a one-liner.
jon: can we run a quick 15m offline sim with the new tokenizer flags? if that reproduces, opt for rollback.
bd-team: draft pushed: "Note: for long sequences embeddings may fallback to CPU; expect minor latency variance."
mia: merged. thanks. ops, what's our rollback plan if it goes bad?
ops-oncall: Plan: if p95 >=20% OR errors >=0.5% for 3m -> auto-rollback allowed. Manual rollback to 2.7.9 if upstream customers report reranker failures or offline sim >7% drift. Command: `/deploy rollback --to 2.7.9 --region=usw --slice=canary`. We'll ping #customer-notify after rollback.
jon: running the sim now (estimated 12m). i'll post results in here.
(12m later)
jon: sim finished: drift at 6.5% across test corpora and p95 on canary trending down to +9% (5m avg).
mia: that's encouraging. given sim <7% and live p95 falling, i'm authorizing a controlled ramp to 30% in 2m. leave auto-rollback on.
deploybot: NOTE: scheduled ramp to 30% in 2 minutes as requested by mia.
ops-oncall: monitoring. if any customer escalations come in, we'll pause and evaluate rollback.
bd-team: sent internal customer note incl. the changed line. no outbound customer email yet until we see ramp stability.
(5m later)
deploybot: RAMP COMPLETE. Canary at 30%. Metrics stable. p95 +8%, errors 0.04%.
mia: closing hold and marking release notes updated. post-rollout action: assign follow-up ticket to investigate why tokenizer change nudged p95 on long sequences. jon, please own the ticket.
jon: will do. thanks team. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: closing monitoring window but keeping an eye for 24h.
